evidence.quote: Our opening term sheet provides a substantial class fund and a separately stated fee request, subject to court approval.

evidence.agent: Whitcombe Reyes LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: Fees were discussed alongside class relief from the outset, not only after agreement on class relief.
If Brightline can increase the class fund to $28 million, we can agree to a $4 million fee-and-expense cap

summary: Plaintiffs raised fee terms in their opening proposals, and fees were discussed before final agreement on class relief. Whitcombe expressly linked agreement to a $4 million fee-and-expense cap to Brightline increasing the class fund. The transcript does not clearly show class counsel prioritizing its own fees over the class, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
